messages:
Marta: Heads up — noticed alert cards in console show SLO breaches while the telemetry view still shows green. Example: tenant t-42 breach at 15:30 but Console card last datapoint 15:28.
Alex: I saw that too earlier, thought it was a UI bug. Is this an eval/ingest timing issue? @Jamal any recent changes?
Jamal: We pushed slo-eval-v2 last week. It adds jitter and moved pruning; evals can emit immediately while ingest pipeline batches every 45–90s.
Samira: Which pipeline? console-ingest? Did we change the window size?
Jamal: Yes, console-ingest still assumes evals within 60s. If an eval happens at t+1 it looks like a 'new' breach until aggregation catches up.
Marta: So we have a race between alert evaluation (backend) and console telemetry (frontend). Result: users see false positives/negatives during rollouts or bursts.
Alex: That's risky — oncall gets paged for noisy breaches. Two possible fixes: align eval windows or surface latency/staleness in the UI.
Samira: Proposal: (1) Add evaluation_ts to alert payload. (2) Show 'telemetry lag' banner when telemetry timestamp < evaluation_ts - 90s. (3) Don't auto-suppress notifications, but mark them as 'possibly stale'.
Jamal: I prefer annotate vs suppress. Suppression could violate notify SLAs for paying customers. Annotating keeps operator informed.
Marta: Agreed. For safety: backend should include evaluation_ts + a boolean 'telemetry_stale' when ingest delta > 120s.
Alex: Implementation plan:
- Backend: add fields {"evaluation_ts": <iso>, "telemetry_stale": bool} to alert webhook
- Frontend: banner + tooltip + link to raw eval logs
- Observability: metric slo.eval.ingest_delta_seconds (p50/p90) and slo.alert.stale_rate per tenant
Samira: I'll prototype the banner today. UI text: "Warning — console telemetry lags the alert evaluation by ~{delta}s. This alert may be based on newer data." tooltip explains root cause.
Jamal: I'll open a PR to add evaluation_ts to the webhook and compute telemetry_stale in the ingestion service. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/slo/eval/pulls/842
Marta: Also add a rollout checklist for eval changes: smoke in staging, measure ingest delta, canary to 1,5,50 tenants before full rollout.
Deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR #842 deployed to staging at 2024-06-21T15:42:10Z :rocket:
Alex: After staging smoke let's do a 1-hour canary tomorrow 08:00 PST. Ops—please have the runbook ready (noise thresholds, how to rollback).
Ops-sid: Ops-sid: noted. I'll add runbook items and alert rules to the ops playbook.
Marta: Thanks everyone. Quick snippet for backend payload (example):
```
{
  "alert_id": "a-123",
  "tenant": "t-42",
  "evaluation_ts": "2024-06-21T15:30:12Z",
  "telemetry_stale": true,
  "message": "SLO breach: availability < 99.9%"
}
```
Jamal: FYI file reference: infra/slo/evaluator.go ~line 412 where we emit alerts.
Alex: I'll add the metric names and dashboards: grafana/dashboard/alerts/slo-eval-ingest.json
Samira: I'll attach the UI mock in the PR and link to this thread.
Marta: :+1: keeping coordination here. Follow-ups: jamal PR link, alex metrics, ops runbook.
Jamal: PR link again: https://git.redwood.ai/slo/eval/pulls/842
Marta: Thanks — closing loop.
